description:
Caught by the quality gate on the develop->main merge (merge touched zero kmux files -- pre-existing).

TWO separate things here; only the first is fixed.

FIXED -- version drift. crates/kmux/docs/man/kmux.1's .TH line said 'RMUX 0.1.0' while CARGO_PKG_VERSION is 0.1.1. bbaefbe bumped kmux to 0.1.1 without updating the manpage. The test cli_args::tests::surface_docs::manpage_surface_matches_implemented_commands_and_aliases is a doc-sync guard and was doing its job correctly -- the DOC was stale, not the test. Bumped to 0.1.1 (and refreshed the .TH date). kmux bin suite now 461 passed / 0 failed.

NOT FIXED, needs the maintainer's call -- branding. The whole manpage is still RMUX-branded ('.TH RMUX', 'rmux \- tmux-compatible terminal multiplexer CLI', 'RMUX is a cross-platform...'), even though aeda6da was explicitly 'Collapse kmux fork into single kmux crate (publishable, no rmux-name squatting)' and the file is named kmux.1. The test itself hardcodes the RMUX expectation (assert manpage.contains(format!("\"RMUX {}\"", CARGO_PKG_VERSION))), so a rebrand touches BOTH doc and test together.

Deliberately NOT blanket-renamed, because it is not a pure find-and-replace: the RMUX_* environment variables documented at lines 222-234 (RMUX_DISABLE_TINY_CLI, RMUX_DISABLE_CLI_TARGET_ACTIONS, RMUX_FULL_BINARY_PATH, RMUX_TINY_TRACE) are REAL variable names the code reads, so renaming those in the doc would make the doc lie, and renaming them in the code is a user-facing breaking change. Someone has to decide which RMUX mentions are branding (rename) and which are actual identifiers (keep) before this is safe to touch.

Relevant since kmux is intended to be publishable -- the manpage is the public face on a crates.io release.
title: kmux: manpage version drifted from the crate (0.1.0 vs 0.1.1), and the manpage is still RMUX-branded
